theme: An open Sunday, with the trip clock running.
greeting: Morning, Dan. Only the 9 o'clock sweep with Mike is fixed today, so the rest is open, and the overdue Croatia bookings are what it's quietly asking for before the Sept 8 departure.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter, in Cavtat near the airport, is p1 and now a week overdue. It has to be booked from dry land before you fly out Sept 8, since connectivity aboard is poor to none.

needsAttention.title: Cover the Sept 20-22 St Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday Sept 20 but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday Sept 22 at 3pm, and those two St Pete nights are still unbooked. p1, five days overdue.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy ticket shows zero checked bags. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy bags now rather than at the counter. p1, five days overdue.

needsAttention.title: Hedge the Sept 20 rental car
needsAttention.detail: Book a refundable Full Size SUV at TPA unless Mike's car is confirmed heading south; the decision point is Sept 7. p2, overdue since Aug 28.
